title: 完全竞争市场（下）：均衡与效率

claims.claim: Under free entry and exit, positive economic profits attract entry and sustained losses induce exit; the process changes market supply.
claims.notes: entry and exit are long-run adjustments

claims.claim: Under competitive assumptions and absent market failures, P=MC supports allocative efficiency; long-run entry and exit can bring price to minimum LRAC.
claims.notes: efficiency is conditional and distinct from equity

claims.claim: For inverse demand 80−Q and MC 20+0.5Q, equilibrium Q40 P40, CS800 PS400 TS1200.
For demand Q=A−4P and long-run price15, per-firm q4, A100→120 implies long-run industry output40→60 and firms10→15.
claims.notes: constant-cost industry assumption; lab reports long-run endpoint
